answer_1.quote: We propose the Paraphrase Augmented Response Generation (PARG), an effective learning framework that jointly optimizes dialog paraphrase and dialog response generation.
answer_1.outputs: dialog responses and paraphrased user utterances

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU to evaluate the language fluency of generated responses.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation to further illustrate PARG's superiority in terms of paraphrase generation. We use one-to-one comparison to evaluate the relative quality of paraphrases generated by PARG versus strong baselines (NAEPara and SRPara).
answer_4.guideline: We ask the judges to choose whether the paraphrase generated by PARG is of better, equal or worse quality than the paraphrase generated by NAEPara or SRPara, given the original utterance.
criteria: similarity of user intent with the original utterance
